approval_evidence.quote: ORLADEYO (berotralstat) capsules, for oral use Initial U.S. Approval: 2020

launch_evidence.quote: sales of ORLADEYO, which the Company began shipping to patients in December 2020

series_start_reason: The U.S. and outside-U.S. split first appears in the Q1 2023 10-Q. Its 2022 quarters are prior-year columns; 2021 quarterly U.S. figures are not printed (only the annual U.S. figure for 2021 in the FY2024 10-K), and the 2021-2022 filings print a combined ORLADEYO line, so the series does not splice onto it. Series therefore starts 2022Q1.
series_end_reason: The 2026 10-Qs print only a combined ORLADEYO line (Q1 2026 148,347; Q2 2026 158,202) with no U.S. row, and the FY2025 10-K is the last filing with a U.S. row for ORLADEYO.
notes: Scope is ORLADEYO U.S. product revenues, the U.S. row under the ORLADEYO heading. Outside-U.S. ORLADEYO (Europe and other markets) is excluded and not spliced. The 2026 combined line includes outside-U.S. sales and is not used. Q4 figures are derived from the full-year U.S. row less nine months, using the annual figures printed in the FY2023, FY2024 and FY2025 10-Ks.
search_log: Bigdata search for ORLADEYO net product revenue by quarter; results confirmed the product's U.S. and outside-U.S. split from 2023.
Listed every 10-Q and 10-K for CIK 882796 via data.sec.gov submissions; read the ORLADEYO U.S. row of each 2023 to 2025 filing and the ORLADEYO line of the 2021-2022 filings.
Checked the 2026 10-Qs for a U.S. row: none; they print only the combined ORLADEYO line.
2022 quarters from the prior-year columns of the 2023 10-Qs; Q4 2022 derived from the FY2024-filing three-year table less nine months.
FDA label for NDA 214094 read for the approval year; the approval letter text layer was unreadable.
